I was trying to purchase 4 Goodyear tires when I came across this website on Google. I saw they had a really good price on those tires, so I proceeded to buy them. At checkout, I entered my debit card information and pressed continue. Then a spinning circle with the word " processing " in it appeared. My bank sent me a code needed to go on with the purchase. At that point, I started becoming suspicious, so I checked my bank's website. To my unpleasant surprise, I saw an unauthorized transaction of $316.40 for JetBlue Airlines flight tickets. I called the bank right away to file a fraud dispute. The agent told me that I had to wait until the transaction posted so I could file a dispute. I called back on Monday the following week to file the dispute since the transaction had already been posted and my money had been taken for good. Unfortunately, and despite the irrefutable evidence of a scam, the bank hasn't credited that money back into my account. I have also file a report with the Joliet Police Department.

I signed up for what I believed to be a free trial on a resume site through ChatGPT. I had attempted to cancel 3 times on my mobile device after I realized it wasnt quite what I was looking for and 7 days later the payment was drafted from my account. I initially was confused because I had cancelled. So I got on my phone to make sure and it hadnt cancelled. So I attempted again. It is discovered you cannot cancel on your mobile device which is not disclosed anywhere on the site or terms and policies. I logged onto my desktop to cancel and was able to do so that way. When I emailed explaining I had proof that I could not cancel on my mobile device although I was told it was cancelled I just requested my refund, They refused. When I told them I had time stamps proving this and that I would be reporting them for deceptive practices, they did not respond.

Instant Hydration offered a deal where you would receive a discounted rate on their product when you sign up for a subscription that you can “cancel anytime”   However their website has no cancellation process and uses a “cancel” button in a  deceptive way.  There is no reminder before you are billed for your next subscription shipment. Then, if you sign on your account and select cancel under manage subscription, it takes you only to a page to delay your subscription shipment. If you select “cancel” on that screen, it only “cancels” the process of delaying your shipment and takes you back to the menu- it does not cancel your subscription.
